slots.hair: long waves, still wet, pushed over one shoulder
slots.outfit: a white silk fine-strap slip with one strap down
slots.place: standing at the floor-to-ceiling window of her apartment with no curtains on it at all, the South Jakarta night outside and one floor lamp on
slots.action: She is leaning against the window frame pushing her freshly washed hair over one shoulder with one hand.
slots.face: Looking calmly at the lens with nothing being performed.
slots.light: The floor lamp is to one side in front of her, the glass carries a little of the room back, and the city outside is dark.

slots.outfit: a rattan-beige silk shirt-style loungewear set undone to the third button
slots.place: half sitting on the edge of the teak low cabinet in her apartment, a single scent diffuser and a small lamp on it
slots.action: She is perched on the edge of the cabinet having just put the lid back on the diffuser, her hand still resting on it.
slots.face: A small amount of smile, the eyes polite but keeping their distance.
slots.light: The small lamp on the cabinet is in front of her and low, the teak turns it warm, and the depth of the room is dark.

slots.hair: long and wet, being coiled up and let go
slots.outfit: a white cotton robe tied loosely with the line of her shoulder showing
slots.place: in the bathroom of her apartment, white tiles and a teak counter, morning light through a high window
slots.action: Her free hand is gathering her long hair up and letting it drop again.
slots.face: The looseness of just having got up, looking at the lens without smiling.
slots.light: The daylight from the high window comes down from in front of her onto her face and shoulders while the inner side of the bathroom falls into shadow.

slots.hair: long waves tucked behind both ears
slots.outfit: a pale green sleeveless linen dress with the belt loosely tied
slots.place: in her own little shop after closing with a single lamp left on, white walls, teak shelving and rattan baskets
slots.action: She is sitting on the edge of the display table with this week's new stock in her hands, trying it herself first.
slots.face: A faint smile, the kind that comes with making a joke about how small the shop is.
slots.light: The lamp on the shelving is in front of her and the depth of the shop is unlit.

slots.outfit: a white fine-strap vest and teak-brown linen trousers, her shoulders and collarbones bare
slots.place: in a coffee shop converted from an old house in South Jakarta in the afternoon, palm shadows falling across a white wall
slots.action: She has just set the cloth bag she brought onto a rattan chair with her hand still on the chair back.
slots.face: Level, looking at the lens, her mouth not moving.
slots.light: The daylight comes in from in front of her while the depth of the room and the palm shadows on the white wall stay darker than she is.
